latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — enables search and retrieval across the Andara Ionic RAG knowledge base and business data.

- Query team, product, business, meeting, and CMS info using PostgreSQL and bash.
- Includes detailed schema for all available tables (knowledge_base, team, CMS, orders, research, more).
- Provides example SQL queries for typical business intelligence and research tasks.
- Enforces read-only data access and concise, case-insensitive search results.
- Includes usage rules for safe, efficient querying (limit results, truncate long content, no writes).
